requirement_correction.original_assumption: Every request on an ended session must reject with InvalidStateError.
requirement_correction.previous_correction_and_error: Issues #39/#40 correctly removed a blanket ended gate but incorrectly extended support-based settlement to requests already pending at shutdown.
requirement_correction.corrected_requirement: Shutdown rejects outstanding reference-space promises, granted and ungranted, with InvalidStateError; end() promises retain their lifecycle. Already settled outcomes remain unchanged. Separately initiated post-shutdown requests retain support-based task settlement. Argument conversion precedes creation/registration of the new Promise, including when coercion shuts down the session.
requirement_correction.rationale: The absence of an ended gate in request/support algorithms does not override the separate shutdown requirement. Cancelled startup continuations must not allocate spaces or resume disposed presentation/input.
requirement_correction.historical_note: Original historical results are unchanged except for an explicit correction reference. Their 995 assertions per browser included incorrect pending-at-end expectations and do not validate this correction.
